_note: BookSchema (ADR-0046 §6 documentation spine). Consumers: the REST `/meta/book/:name/tree` endpoint (packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:3078-3169) driving the spec's pure resolveBookTree/audienceAllows (packages/spec/src/system/book.zod.ts), and objectui's console docs portal (apps/console/src/pages/book-nav.ts @940ba24 — a faithful resolver port rendering the reader UI, plus portal-only consumers for slug/icon/order). 15 of 17 live; the two dead entries are both inline `translations` maps that LOOK like the doc-level mechanism that works (`doc.translations`, resolveDocLocale) but have no resolver anywhere. Seeded 2026-08-01 (#4488).

name.note: tree-route identity; an unknown name is treated as a package id and resolved as the implicit per-package book (§6.4).

label.note: carried into the resolved tree; portal cards fall back to `name`.

description.note: portal landing-card subtitle. The framework tree omits it; the portal reads it off the raw /meta/book item.

slug.note: portal URL segment (`/docs/<slug>`), defaulting to `name`. Portal-side consumer only — the framework tree endpoint routes by `name`.

order.note: orders books on the portal landing (then label, stable). Authored books always sort ahead of synthetic per-package ones regardless of `order`.

audience.note: ENFORCED access gate (§6.7), fail-closed: gates the whole tree (401 anonymous / 403 non-holder), and every doc's effective audience is the union over the books that claim it (resolveDocAudiences) — applied to both doc lists and tree entries. The one security-shaped property on this type, and it is real.

key.note: group identity: explicit `doc.group` placement matches on it, and it keys the resolved tree.

label.note: section title in the resolved tree.

translations.note: CROSS-REPO RE-VERIFIED 2026-08-09 against objectui @c2fd1223 (#4895 task 1): confirmed. objectui models the book spine independently (apps/console/src/pages/book-nav.ts `Book` / `BookGroup`) and neither interface declares `translations`, so no renderer ever consumed the inline maps. REMOVED 2026-08-02 (#4667) — tombstoned at the schema (retiredKey carries the prescription; authoring it is a tsc error and a parse error) and stripped from sources by the protocol-17 conversion. The entry stays because retiredKey keeps the key in the walked shape (the rls.priority precedent). TOMBSTONE rather than delete because BookGroupSchema is a plain z.object with NO .strict() — a bare delete would have zod silently strip the key, trading one silent no-op for another. No resolver read inline book/group translations; group labels rendered verbatim in every locale. Localize the DOCS instead: doc.translations is live on every doc render path.

order.note: orders groups within the book (0 default, then declaration order).

include.note: the derived-membership rule — the heart of the §6.2.1 design. CAVEAT, recorded not hidden: only the GLOB form can match today. The `{ tag }` variant is declared and the resolver implements it (matchesInclude reads doc.tags), but DocSchema declares no `tags` property, so the corpus always carries `tags: undefined` and a tag rule matches nothing. Either add `doc.tags` or retire the variant (enforce-or-remove).

package.note: scopes the rule to a package id (cross-package books, ADR-0048).

pages.note: explicit curated-order override; `---` separators and `...` rest-expansion both implemented, node label/badge/icon overrides carried into entries.

groups.note: Drilled because `translations` diverges (dead) from its six live siblings.
